key_insight: A teacher helps best when its guidance matches the student’s current policy, not just when the teacher is stronger.
engineering_relevance: JOLT provides a practical training recipe for improving sample efficiency and performance in long-horizon reasoning systems by combining privileged teacher learning with on-policy student distillation.
method: Analyze when a privileged teacher’s distillation update aligns with the student’s reward gradient.
Train a single policy in two roles: a KL-regularized privileged teacher and an unprivileged student.
Use on-policy dense token-level distillation plus student rewards to improve teaching quality and learning efficiency.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improvements across mathematical reasoning, coding, tool use, and terminal use, with additional gains when student rewards are included.
watch_item: Privileged teachers can still harm learning if they exploit shortcuts unavailable to the student, so the teacher objective must be carefully aligned with the student’s capabilities.
paper_title: A Good Self-Teacher Meets the Student Where They Are: Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching
